class.name: SuperposLockstepServer
class.brief_description: Server half of deterministic input streaming: per-peer jitter buffers in, delta-compressed command stream out.
class.description: Accepts each client's redundant input batches into a per-slot adaptive playout buffer and releases one input per server tick, two while catching up, none while buffering. Starvation raises a slot's target depth; a calm buffer slowly lowers it again. A tick lost beyond the client's redundancy is skipped and counted, never invented. The server records every slot's consumed input with [method begin_tick], [method set_command] and [method end_tick]. [method pack_commands] then encodes only the inputs that changed, for every tick after the one a client last acknowledged, so all clients can advance the same deterministic world. [codeblock] var lockstep := SuperposLockstepServer.new() lockstep.configure(4, 101, {"initial_target": 6}) # On a received input payload from player slot s: lockstep.accept_inputs(s, payload) # Every server tick: lockstep.begin_tick(tick) for s in 101: for item in lockstep.consume_inputs(s): lockstep.set_command(s, item.input) lockstep.end_tick() var batch := lockstep.pack_commands(lockstep.get_playout_status(s).command_acknowledged) if batch.error == OK: session.enqueue_packet(batch.payload, COMMAND_CHANNEL) [/codeblock] Methods must be called on the owning thread.

method.name: accept_inputs
method.description: Decodes a batch packed by [method SuperposLockstepClient.pack_inputs] into the playout buffer of [param slot]. Duplicate and already-consumed ticks are counted and ignored. Malformed or wrong-width batches return an error and change nothing.

method.name: begin_tick
method.description: Opens the command table for [param tick]. Ticks must be contiguous. Slots not set during the tick keep their previous input.

method.name: configure
method.description: Sets the fixed input width (1-16 bytes), the slot count (1-256) and optional playout tuning: [code]initial_target[/code] (default 6 ticks), [code]minimum_target[/code] (2), [code]maximum_target[/code] (45, below 128), [code]relax_ticks[/code] (240) and [code]catch_up_margin[/code] (12), and command-stream sizing: [code]command_history_ticks[/code] (128, up to 65536) is the window in which a slow joiner or a stalled client catches up without another keyframe, [code]command_change_capacity[/code] (0 sizes for every slot changing on every retained tick) caps the shared change entries, and [method pack_stream] policy: [code]stream_redundant_ticks[/code] (1) and [code]stream_catch_up_ticks[/code] (30). History is allocated once here. Unknown keys return [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER].

method.name: consume_inputs
method.description: Advances the playout buffer of [param slot] by one server tick and returns zero, one or two Dictionaries containing [code]tick[/code] and [code]input[/code].

method.name: end_tick
method.description: Seals the open command tick into the bounded change history ([code]command_history_ticks[/code]). The oldest ticks are evicted when history is full.

method.name: get_command_tick
method.description: Returns the newest sealed command tick, or [code]0[/code].

method.name: get_oldest_command_tick
method.description: Returns the oldest retained command tick. [method pack_commands] can resume any client that acknowledged at least the tick before it.

method.name: get_playout_status
method.description: Returns [code]active[/code], [code]received_tick[/code], [code]consumed_tick[/code], [code]command_acknowledged[/code], [code]buffered[/code], [code]target[/code], [code]starvations[/code], [code]duplicates[/code], [code]late[/code], [code]skipped[/code], [code]playing[/code] and [code]pace_advice[/code] in [-1, 1]. A positive value asks that client to simulate slightly faster, a negative value slightly slower. Send [code]received_tick[/code] back to the client for [method SuperposLockstepClient.acknowledge_inputs].

method.name: pack_commands
method.description: Encodes every sealed tick after [param after_tick] that fits whole in [param max_bytes]. Each changed slot travels as a slot gap, a changed-byte mask and only the changed bytes. With [param recipient] set to a slot, that slot's processed client ticks (see [method set_command]) ride along so a predicting client reconciles without stamping ticks into its broadcast input. Returns [code]error[/code] and [code]payload[/code]. [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] means the requested ticks were evicted; send [method pack_keyframe] together with a world snapshot instead.

method.name: pack_command_window
method.description: Fresh-first streaming for unreliable channels. Encodes every tick after [param sent_tick] that fits whole in [param max_bytes], then uses remaining space for up to [param redundant_ticks] already-sent ticks after [param acknowledged_tick], so an isolated lost batch heals without a round trip while fresh ticks never starve. With nothing fresh it resends the newest unacknowledged ticks. Returns [code]error[/code] and [code]payload[/code] like [method pack_commands]; rewind [param sent_tick] to [param acknowledged_tick] when acknowledgements stall for longer than a round trip.

method.name: pack_stream
method.description: Next command batch for [param slot]'s client, from its own native sender state: fresh-first windows carrying its processed ticks, one rewind to its acknowledgement after a stall of 2 x [param srtt_usec] plus its ack cadence, and [code]stream_redundant_ticks[/code] of redundancy only while it is within [code]stream_catch_up_ticks[/code] of the newest tick. Pass the session's [code]smoothed_rtt_us[/code]. Returns [code]error[/code] and [code]payload[/code]; [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] means its acknowledgement left history: send a keyframe and call [method reset_stream].

method.name: reset_stream
method.description: Restarts [param slot]'s sender after a keyframe join at [param keyframe_tick].

method.name: pack_keyframe
method.description: Encodes the complete command table at [method get_command_tick] for [method SuperposLockstepClient.load_keyframe].

method.name: set_command
method.description: Sets the consumed input of [param slot] for the open tick, and the client tick it came from ([code]0[/code] when held or invented). A slot left unset keeps both.
